# RedotPay Independent Educational Guide & Referral Hub
> Comprehensive, independent reference guide for RedotPay crypto Visa debit cards, referral codes, fees, and KYC requirements.

## Core Summary
- Referral Code: `sg6r9`
- Direct Referral Link: https://url.hk/i/en/sg6r9
- Signup Bonus: Up to $5 USD credit credited upon completing Level 1 identity verification (Sumsub KYC).
- Key Rule: Referral code MUST be entered during registration; it cannot be applied after registration.
- Card Formats: Virtual Visa ($10 one-time fee) & Physical Visa ($100 one-time fee).
- Contactless: Supports Apple Pay and Google Pay.
- Supported Currencies: USDT (TRC20, BSC, Arbitrum, ERC20), USDC, BTC, ETH, SOL, BNB, XRP.
- Fees: 0% maintenance, 1.0% crypto conversion, 1.2% FX rate for non-USD spending.
- Restricted Jurisdictions: USA, Mainland China, Russia, and sanctioned regions.
